mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 44 degrees with clear skies near the Military Ridge State Trail, and we are under a waning crescent moon.

The city has announced upcoming pavement repairs for November 10 and 11 on streets including Morningside Boulevard and Mozart Street. Also, the Plan Commission will meet on December 7 to discuss development projects like the Sub-Zero proposal for Liberty Business Park.
There is a busy schedule ahead with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard, plus trivia and music events tomorrow at Paddy Mac's and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
On October 22, a vehicle collided with a Metro Bus on West Verona Avenue, resulting in a citation for the driver for failure to yield the right of way.
Today's delicious flavor is Chocolate Volcano. The store is currently open and will be serving up treats until their closing time at 10:30 PM.
